relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: treatment with CGRP significantly increased the expression of both EZH2 and H3K27me3 protein levels in microglia

relationships.subject: EZH2
relationships.evidence_quote: EZH2 is a methyltransferase that catalyzes H3K27me3.

relationships.subject: GSK126
relationships.evidence_quote: inhibition of CGRP and EZH2 can prevent the nerve injury-induced neuropathic pain

relationships.subject: CGRP8-37
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared with CCI alone, CCI with GSK126 and CGRP8-37 markedly reversed the CCI-induced increase of both EZH2 and H3K27me3 protein expressions

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP significantly increased ITGAM, ADAM10, MCP-1, and CX3CR1 protein levels in microglia following CGRP treatment, whereas EZH2 inhibitor partially or completely blocked these CGRP increase effects

relationships.subject: PKA/PKC pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: PKI6-22 and chelerythrine chloride (PKA and PKC inhibitors) partially or completely blocked the increased effect of CGRP on EZH2 and H3K27me3 expressions

key_findings: CGRP raises EZH2/H3K27me3 in spinal microglia via PKA/PKC and drives microglial activation markers in CCI rats
CGRP antagonist and EZH2 inhibitor attenuate CCI hyperalgesia
